verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence says Spline's native file format is open, specified, or documented for third-party tools. The documented exports (code exports for Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, and a self-hosted ZIP that bundles the Spline runtime) are adjacent export features. They do not make the design file itself portable or toolable outside the editor, and the docs also say files live in the cloud.

support.subject: As a developer, the file format is open or documented, so my designs stay portable and toolable outside the vendor's editor

citations.quote: Spline allows you to export the code of your scene as: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber
allows you to export your entire project, including all assets and the Spline runtime, as a fully self-contained ZIP file
